people.imagined: Evening in his own bare hall. He sits on the stone floor because chairs break, one knee up, the red banner furled across his lap. He has just been told another letter came from the Fire Court and is deciding not to read it yet. The vent glows behind him.
people.subject: The moment: he sits cross-legged on a bare stone floor in the evening, with a furled red banner across his thighs, looking straight at the viewer with his chin lowered. Face (most important: the arms and neck are glossy red): a broad square face with a heavy jaw, a short thick bull neck and skin burned to a smooth glossy red from the jaw down and across both shoulders, shining like polished brick; above the jaw the face is weathered brown; a flat nose bent once, thick black brows, small dark eyes with deep creases at the corners; a short black stubble beard. Hair: black, cropped close to the skull, a few white hairs above the ears. Body: enormously broad, thick through the chest and upper arms, arms bare to the shoulder and scarred with pale lines from wrist to shoulder, countless thin white lines on the glossy red. Clothing: no sleeves at all; a plain sleeveless vest of dark undyed cotton open at the chest, and a wide sash of bright red cloth wound three times round the waist, the tail hanging in his lap. Hands and objects: both big hands rest on a furled crimson banner of heavy silk with a long cloud-shaped end, plain without any marks; a small red-orange jade feather the length of a finger hangs on a cord at his throat. Background: bare dark stone wall, and low behind him the orange glow of a vent through a doorway. Light: warm key light from the upper left; orange light from the vent rims his shoulders. A faint haze of heat. Expression: patient and heavy, the mouth set, a hint of forgiveness in the eyes.

people.imagined: He is bent over a weiqi board on a flat sitting stone after the day's sitting, a black stone between two fingers. He tilts his head because he is listening to the vent through the floor, not to the person who has just spoken.
people.subject: The moment: he sits at a weiqi board on a low stone and tilts his head to one side, one ear toward the ground, with a black stone held above the board. Face (most important: the head tilt, and skin burned smooth and shiny): a compact round-jawed face with skin burned shiny and smooth as glazed pottery on the cheeks and forehead, without wrinkles; no eyebrows to speak of, only a faint grey line; narrow grey-brown eyes that look past the viewer; a flat nose, a thin patient mouth. Hair: grey, cropped to a quarter inch, bristling. Body: short, dense and square, thick forearms. Clothing: a sleeveless dark-red tunic cut for sitting, bare arms pale-white with fine scar lines from wrist to shoulder, wound with a dark-red sash. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a black round weiqi stone between index and middle finger; the left rests on a square wooden board with a grid of fine lines and a few black and white stones; a dull iron ring as thick as a thumb on his left fist. Background: dark cave wall with a faint orange glow on one side. Light: warm light from the upper left on the board and his hands. Expression: calm, patient, calculating; the slight smile of a man who has already seen the next move.

people.imagined: She stands on the vent's flank at night, counting. In her left hand a cord with knots, her thumb on the last knot. The sulphur has dusted her hair and shoulders grey.
people.subject: The moment: at night on the vent's flank she holds a long knotted cord in both hands and looks down at it, then up at the viewer. Face: a long, calm oval face, skin dusted grey-yellow with sulphur at the brows and hairline; deep-set dark eyes with faint red rims from the fumes; high cheekbones; a straight mouth, lips slightly cracked; no ornament. Hair: black streaked with grey, dusted pale, braided in a single plain braid down the front of her left shoulder, the braid tied with a strip of red cloth. Body: slim and upright, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a sleeveless dark-red vest cut high at the neck, bare forearms pale with a few fine scar lines, a red sash; over her shoulders a pale grey cotton shawl dusted with sulphur. Hands and objects: a hemp cord as long as her arm in both hands, with about forty knots tied along it, some knots clean and tight, three untied loops hanging loose; her thumb pressed on one knot. Background: dark rock and a glow of orange in a crack below, drifting yellow sulphur smoke. Light: orange from below left, cool blue moonlight from the upper left. Expression: composed, devout, the faint weariness of a person who keeps count.

people.imagined: On the palace road at midday, he has just spat into the dust at the sight of the envoy's banner. He wears a merchant's good coat because he never stopped, with the hall's red sash over it.
people.subject: The moment: on a sunlit road at midday he glares sideways at something off-frame, jaw pushed forward, a breath from spitting into the dust at the sight of an envoy's banner. Face (most important: the nose, smashed flat and bent hard to the left): a wide, red-cheeked face with a loud shouting mouth, a thick black moustache, heavy brows drawn together over bright dark eyes, and the flattened nose that makes every scowl lopsided. Hair: thick black hair tied back in a short tail with a red cord. Body: thick-chested with heavy shoulders, a big man gone broad, planted wide on the road. Clothing: a good wine-coloured silk merchant's coat with wide cuffs and brass buttons, kept from his trading days and worn open over a bare chest; across it a broad crimson sash of the hall tied at the waist with a heavy knot; the left sleeve is pushed up to show a scarred forearm. Hands and objects: one fist planted on his hip; in the other hand a short levy officer's baton of dark wood with a red tassel. Background: a dusty brown road, a low line of hills and a pale sky. Light: hard noon light from the upper left, throwing strong shadows under the brows and the nose. Expression: a wrathful, belligerent scowl, the mouth set in a sneer and the nostrils flared, loud even in silence and not a trace of a smile.

people.imagined: At the dark of the moon at the Lower Mouth, she holds the cord and shows her left palm to someone who doubts her. The lamp is shaded; she is lying calmly.
people.subject: The moment: in lamplight at the dark of the moon she holds up her open left hand toward the viewer, palm out, showing a pale cord scar, calmly lying to someone who doubts her. Face: a round, quick, friendly face with olive skin, a small snub nose, a mole under the right eye, wide brown eyes that hold a little too steady, and a small mouth with one corner lifted. Hair: black, in two high round buns on top tied with red cord. Body: small, sturdy and round-shouldered, standing close to the lamp. Clothing: a sleeveless red tunic cut short, with a stiff standing collar, of good dyed cloth, bare arms with two faint scar lines, and a red sash with a short tail. Hands and objects (the scar is the lead, big and plain): the left palm is raised open at shoulder height, a milk-white raised scar a finger wide running straight across it from the base of the index finger to the heel of the hand; her right hand grips the end of a hemp cord that runs out of frame. Background: dark vent rock and a shaded lantern hung on a hook, moonless dark beyond. Light: a small warm lamp from the lower right lights her chin and the open palm, and the rest falls into dark. Expression: an open, friendly face and a steady, easy smile that holds a lie without a flicker, calm eyes and no sign of strain.

people.imagined: He is weighing a sack of charcoal at a beam scale, his thumb pressed on the beam while his face shows nothing. White stone dust clings to his brows and shoulders.
people.subject: The moment: he presses his thumb on the arm of a hanging beam scale while looking innocently at the viewer, as if nothing is happening. Face (most important: the brows, thick and chalk-white with stone dust): a lean, narrow face with a long nose and a mouth pulled thin, small shrewd grey eyes, hollow cheeks under the cheekbones, deep lines at the mouth filled with fine pale dust, and pale dry skin dusted with red-white powder at the hairline. Hair: thin grey hair slicked back under a plain brown cloth cap. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered and stooped a little over his work. Clothing: a clean brown cotton work coat with sleeves rolled, the collar carefully stitched with red thread, a leather apron with dust in its pockets, and the hall's red sash tied round the apron. Hands and objects: a wooden beam scale hangs from a cord, a black sack of charcoal on one pan and a small iron weight on the other; his right thumb is tucked under the beam. Background: stacked sacks of charcoal and a heap of dull-red stones, behind them a low wall of red-brown stone blocks and a wooden cart. Light: warm light from the upper left, with a thin bar of dust-filled sunlight across his shoulder where the dust glitters like powdered rust. Expression: a cautious, cunning look, the mouth held perfectly straight while the eyes are quietly pleased with themselves, the face of a man who has never been caught.

people.imagined: He holds up a handful of straws at a road post, the short one bent between his fingers, and has already chosen the man he dislikes.
people.subject: The moment: he holds out a closed fist with several straw ends showing and offers the viewer a choice, with a stubborn half-smile. Face (most important: the left ear is missing its lobe, a clean notch edged with a thin pink scar): a square brown face with a heavy chin, a short flat nose, a squinting left eye, a wide mouth shut in a lopsided smile and black stubble; the right ear is whole, with a single gold ring in its rim. Hair: black, short and unkempt under a brown headband. Body: tough, thick-armed and of medium height, standing with weight on one leg. Clothing: a sleeveless brown-red vest over a dark cotton shirt rolled to the elbow, a red sash with the knot at his belly, a leather wrist guard on the right forearm, and across his chest a canvas strap hung with small wooden road-post tokens; four pale scars show on his left forearm. Hands and objects: the right fist closed round the ends of five dry straw stalks, one of them plainly bent shorter; the left thumb hooked in his sash. Background: a roadside post of grey wood and a dusty slope, a rutted cart track running away behind it into brown grassland, distant smoke from a vent on the horizon. Light: warm sun from the upper left, his shadow long across the road, the straws casting thin lines on his knuckles. Expression: a shut, lopsided half-smile of stubborn confidence, the eyes bright with the pleasure of being the one who decides.

people.imagined: She is about to read a name aloud in a dark cave mouth, but first she coughs into her sleeve, covering her mouth with the red cloth.
people.subject: The moment: she lifts a wide sleeve to her mouth in a cough, eyes watching the viewer above it, just before she reads a name aloud at a dark cave mouth. Face: a thin, pale, scholarly face with hollow cheeks, dark circles under the eyes, a long straight nose, thin brows lifted slightly in worry, chapped and faintly bluish lips, and a cough-flushed spot high on each cheekbone. Hair: black, in a tight low knot at the nape with a plain wooden pin, a few wisps stuck to the damp forehead. Body: slight, narrow-shouldered and stooped over her papers. Clothing: a long-sleeved dark-red robe of fine cloth, unlike the sleeveless dress of most of the hall, with the sleeves cut loose and wide so they hide her hands; a narrow red sash; ink stains on the right cuff; the sleeve she coughs into is paler from long wiping. Hands and objects: the left sleeve raised to cover her mouth; the right hand holds a long bundle of narrow bamboo slips tied with red cord against her chest, plain and unmarked. Background: a dim cave mouth, the wall of wet black basalt streaked with orange from a vent glow, a rough rope handrail disappearing into the dark, and a hanging oil lamp. Light: a dim warm lamp from the upper left and deep shadow beyond, dust motes and a thin drift of sulphur smoke rising through the circle of light. Expression: a watchful, cautious look with a faint honest worry in the lifted brows, eyes steady over the sleeve.

people.imagined: He sits on the hot rock after a bout, knuckles on his knees, still thinking about the question someone asked a moment ago.
people.subject: The moment: he sits very still on hot rock after a bout with his heavy fists on his knees and his eyes a half-beat late, staring dully at the viewer, still working out a question someone asked a moment ago. Face (most important: the knuckles, flat and ground smooth as river stones, grey-white and shiny): a broad flat face with a low forehead, small close-set eyes under heavy lids, a thick neck, a nose broken twice, a slack mouth half open, thick cauliflowered ears on both sides, and a long old white scar from the corner of the left eye down into the stubble. Hair: coarse black hair cut short with a knife. Body: very wide and slope-shouldered with heavy forearms, a block of a man. Clothing: a sleeveless brown-red vest, bare arms with flat pale scars, a leather wrist-wrap on each arm black with sweat, and a red sash of good cloth wound four times round the waist, thick as a rope. Hands and objects: both fists laid on his knees in clear view, no weapon. Background: dark vent rock with a warm orange haze at the left, a ladder of dark stone steps leading down to a wide platform with a bucket and a dipper on it. Light: warm from the upper left, with a heat shimmer wavering above the rock behind him, his shadow short and square. Expression: a dull, heavy stare, the mouth slack and the brow furrowed with slow effort, a half-second behind everything around him, with a latent anger he has not yet found a reason for.

people.imagined: She walks past with her hand in a pocket and the lead filings shake like seeds; she stops to weigh a stone carefully and glances back.
people.subject: The moment: she holds a small brass scale up at chest height and looks at the viewer sharply, as if daring them to dispute the weight. Face: a long, narrow, serious face with a high forehead, level straight brows, wary dark eyes narrowed, a sharp chin, a pinched, honest mouth. Her right cheek has a small old burn mark the size of a thumbnail, and her lashes are short and dark. Hair: black, parted in the middle, pinned in a tight flat coil at the back with a brass pin. Body: lean, tall, a straight back. Clothing: a sleeveless red tunic over a brown cotton under-shirt with long sleeves buttoned at the wrist; a red sash; a canvas pouch at the hip with a bulge of grey grit. A flat leather apron with a long row of narrow pockets covers the tunic, each pocket holding a small lead weight, and her sleeves are pinned up with brass pins. Hands and objects: a small hand balance of brass with two flat pans in her right hand, a dull-red stone on one pan and a lead weight on the other, level; her left hand pressed to the pocket at her hip. Background: stacked red stones on a rough table. The table is rough planks, with a neat row of small stone samples laid in order of colour, from pale pink to deep brick red. Light: cool daylight from the upper left, glinting off the brass. A small lamp stands at her elbow, adding a faint gold edge to the brass. Expression: a tight, straight mouth and sharp, narrowed eyes, brows drawn slightly together, challenging any dispute of the weight.

people.imagined: At the Lower Mouth on a moonless night she stands guard; someone has asked who came down the rock, and she answers 'a dream' in her gravel voice, her hand held out for the rice.
people.subject: The moment: on a moonless night she stands in the dark with a palm held out flat toward the viewer, asking to be paid, her mouth open to answer low in a gravel voice. Face: a hard young face with high flat cheekbones, a square jaw, narrow black eyes with a glint, a small scar through the left eyebrow, cracked lips, a wide mouth with a thin upper lip, cords standing in the neck, and a small hollow that dimples the left cheek when she half-smiles. Hair: black, cut at the jaw, with a red cord tied round the head. Body: wiry and forward-leaning, ready to move. Clothing: a sleeveless dark-red tunic cut to the thigh with a stitched border in slightly darker thread, a wide red sash tied with a flat square knot over the left hip, bare arms with scar lines and a dark leather bracer on the left forearm. Hands and objects: the right palm out and open at chest height; in the left hand a short iron-shod staff held against her shoulder. Background: night, with tall dark vertical rock walls on both sides of her, a low orange glow from a crack at the left base and a few sparks drifting upward. Light: orange from the lower left runs along the edge of her jaw and the iron shoe of the staff; cold dark everywhere else. Expression: a hungry, sly look, one eyebrow cocked and the half-smile ready, loyal but always counting what she is owed.

people.imagined: At dusk he kneels over the same bundle, tying and untying it again, the ash from the palace still grey in its folds; he looks up when someone passes.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk he kneels over an open cloth bundle, his hands in the middle of retying it, and glances up at the viewer with a quick wide smile. Face: a young open face, round with a rough chin, quick friendly brown eyes, thick expressive brows, one a little higher than the other with a small scar through the left, ash-grey smudges across the left cheek, a snub nose and a gap between the front teeth. Hair: dark brown, sticking up, tied in a tuft with a bit of red thread. Body: skinny and long-limbed, folded awkwardly on his knees. Clothing: a sleeveless red tunic a size too wide for him over a clean grey cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled, a narrow red sash wound twice and tied in a loose bow as if he was told how and never remembered, and a pair of pale grey rope sandals set at his knee. Hands and objects: a square bundle of coarse grey cloth held open with ash in its folds, a wooden comb and a folded shirt visible, his fingers on the knot. Background: a doorway of dark rock and a faint orange evening sky, rows of small round stones marking sleeping places on the ledge and a thin line of smoke climbing from the vent village far below. Light: warm dusk light from the upper left, the deep orange at the horizon dyeing the top of his hair and the edges of the bundle. Expression: a quick, eager smile with a flicker of uncertainty behind it, the look of a boy split between two doors and charming both of them.

people.imagined: In the cooled lava among the standing dead she taps one marker with a tin ladle, saying the name under her breath; she has done it every day for years.
people.subject: The moment: she stands among low black stone markers, tapping the nearest with a tin ladle, and turns her calm face to the viewer. Face: a broad, calm, plain face with a full chin and wide cheeks, brown skin, peaceful lowered eyelids, a straight mouth and a wide forehead with two soft lines; no ornaments. The skin of her face is smooth and brown with a pair of deep dimples when she smiles, and the corners of her eyes crease gently. Hair: black with a lot of grey, tied in a low bun under a faded red headcloth. Body: broad and solid, comfortable and slow. Clothing: a sleeveless dull-red tunic cut longer than the others, a clean grey apron over it, a red sash, soft cloth shoes; no sign of Fire on her arms, which are brown and unscarred. The red headcloth is faded to a pale rose and knotted at the back, and the tunic's hem is dusted grey with ash from the lava. Hands and objects: a long-handled tin ladle with a dented bowl in her right hand, raised to touch a rough black stone post; behind her more posts in rows. Background: cooled black lava with rows of upright stones, a pale orange evening sky. The markers are rough dark stones the height of a child, standing in even rows, each with a tiny wisp of dry grass pushed into a crack at its foot. Light: low warm light from the upper left. Her shadow stretches long and soft over the lava, and a thin warm line of light rims the tin ladle. Expression: a calm, content face with soft eyes resting on the markers and a small settled line at the mouth, as at a daily habit.

people.imagined: He turns his chin to show the scar and tells again the story of the palace fan; his bare arm is out and he is flexing it for show.
people.subject: The moment: he lifts his chin and turns his face sideways to show a scar on the jaw, and grins with contempt. Face (most important: a pale curved scar across the chin, wide and plain): a sharp handsome face with a cocky tilted chin, a long pale scar running from the left corner of his mouth across the point of his chin, narrow arrogant eyes with a gleam, thick dark eyebrows, a wide cruel half-grin. His skin is clear and tanned, the nose long and straight, and one of his front teeth is slightly longer than the other. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a red cord, a shaved patch behind one ear. Body: athletic, broad in the shoulders, flexed. Clothing: a sleeveless red tunic cut to the ribs, the right arm bare with five pale scar lines and a bound leather wrist wrap, a red sash tied in a loop at the belt. Five pale scar lines run from wrist to shoulder on the bare arm, a sixth just begun and pink, and a strip of red cloth is tied round the upper arm like a trophy. Hands and objects: the right fist raised and flexed in front of the chest. Background: dark vent rock and an orange haze. A line of younger disciples sits blurred along the vent rock behind him, watching, and the hot rock steams in places. Light: warm from the upper left, a hard highlight on the scar. A hard bright highlight crosses his scar and the top of the raised fist, and his eyes shine with pleasure. Expression: a grin held a beat too long, chin high, one brow arched and the eyes looking down his nose at the viewer.

people.imagined: He has just climbed a few steps and sits on the landing to catch his breath, blue shirt hanging loose on thin arms; an angry blister on one arm.
people.subject: The moment: he sits on a stone step, a little out of breath, looking up at the viewer with a gentle tired smile. Face: a thin, pale young face with a long narrow nose, large soft brown eyes with dark rings under them, a mild open mouth, faint sweat at the temples. His ears are slightly large and pink at the edges, his lips are thin and dry, and a faint spatter of freckles covers the bridge of his nose. Hair: black, short and soft, parted to one side. Body: slight and narrow, thin wrists. Clothing: a blue cotton caravan shirt a size too large, with sleeves rolled twice and slipping down, over it a short sleeveless red tunic with the hall's red sash tied twice at the waist; on his right forearm a pink blister mark the shape of a hand. The blue shirt is faded to a soft sky colour with a small neat patch on the shoulder, and the red sash hangs loosely over his narrow hips. Hands and objects: both hands on his knees, thin wrists showing; a small water gourd on a cord at his shoulder. Background: pale grey stone steps and a hazy sky. A long stair of cooled lava rises behind him, with a few pale grey flowers growing from the cracks, and a thin plume of steam climbs far off. Light: soft daylight from the upper left. The hazy air takes the colour out of everything beyond him, so his blue shirt is the brightest thing in the frame. Expression: a gentle tired smile, lips slightly parted for breath, brows soft and a damp sheen at the temples.

people.imagined: On the wharf at home she grins at a rude sailor, a chipped front tooth showing, her fists up and ready.
people.subject: The moment: on the wharf at home she grins widely straight at the viewer with her fists raised at chest height in a rough boxer's guard, answering a rude sailor. Face (most important: a chipped front tooth, a clear triangular gap in the upper left incisor, showing in the grin): a sunburned round face with freckles, bright dark eyes narrowed with laughter, strong level dark brows with a split in the left one, a short snub nose, and a faint white scar across the chin. Hair: black and thick, in a single messy tail tied with red string, loose strands blown across her face. Body: short and stocky with thick arms, braced on a wide stance. Clothing: a sleeveless red tunic of good cloth cut short at the hip with a slim dark border along the hem, bare strong arms with a bruise on one, a red sash tied in a harbour rope knot, and a bracelet of ten wooden beads on the left wrist. Hands and objects: both fists up, knuckles forward. Background: a blue harbour sky crossed by tall wooden masts in pale diagonals, a wooden bollard, and a coil of thick rope on a low wall beside her. Light: bright sea light from the upper left, the glare lighting the underside of her chin and the white edge of the chipped tooth. Expression: a wide, cocky, stubborn grin, chin lifted and eyes dancing, the look of a girl who likes a fight and likes the crowd even more.

people.imagined: He sits on a sack of rice at the Lower Mouth, turning his hands over in the light; the soot on his fingertips will not wash out and he keeps it that way.
people.subject: The moment: he holds up his hands, palms toward himself, and studies the black on his fingertips, then looks at the viewer sideways, eyes narrowed. Face: a smooth sly young face, narrow dark eyes with a gleam, a thin pointed nose, a thin mouth with one corner up, a small black beard patch under the lip. His skin is pale and smooth, his eyes are slightly slanted, and the faint shadow of a first moustache lies on his upper lip. Hair: black, combed back and tied with a red cord, one lock hanging by the cheek. Body: slender and wiry, loose-shouldered. Clothing: a sleeveless red tunic cut at the ribs, wearing under it the stiff-collared dark shirt of the palace's servants, the sleeves cut off at the elbow, with the hall's red sash knotted over it. Beneath the red tunic the grey servant's shirt shows at the collar, stiff and standing, and the red sash is tied in a careful palace knot. Hands and objects: ten fingertips that are black with a palm's palace soot, in the frame and plain against the pale palms; on his knee a small cloth sack of rice. Background: a dusty stone ledge and a faint orange glow. Sacks of rice are stacked in a rough pile behind him, and above them the dark rock arch of the Lower Mouth, with a lantern hung from a hook. Light: warm from the upper left. The soot on his fingertips seems darker against the warm light, almost blue at the edges. Expression: a half-hidden smirk at one corner of the mouth, eyes narrowed and glancing sideways, a charming and not quite honest face.

people.imagined: He lies dozing at the edge of the charcoal pit in the afternoon, hat tipped on his face, in a neat brown work coat; one eye cracks open when the cooks' boy shouts.
people.subject: The moment: half asleep, he leans back on a heap of black charcoal sacks with a straw hat tipped back on his head and one eye open at the viewer. Face: a round, kind, lazy face, fat cheeks smudged with soot, a short wide nose, small contented eyes that squint, a broad slack mouth, a grey stubble beard. His cheeks are round with soft creases and his nose is bulbous and shiny, with a grey stubble that follows the jaw. Hair: grey and thinning, under a wide conical straw hat. Body: stout, a round belly, loose. Clothing: a clean dark-brown hemp work coat with rolled sleeves, black at the cuffs from charcoal, a wide cloth belt in dull green, grey trousers tied at the ankle; there is no red sash since he is a servant. The work coat has a green cloth patch over one elbow and a row of tiny scorch holes along the left sleeve, and a clay pipe is tucked behind one ear. Hands and objects: arms folded across the belly, black fingers; a short-handled wooden rake leaning on his shoulder. Background: a smoky charcoal pit, sacks and a pale blue sky. Black mounds of charcoal rise behind him with a thin spiral of smoke, and a pair of crows sit on the edge of the pit. Light: soft smoky afternoon light from the upper left. The smoke softens the light into a warm grey-gold haze, and his shadow is soft and wide. Expression: a lazy half-smile, one eye cracked open and the other shut, the face slack and comfortable under the tipped hat.

people.imagined: Memorial of the boy who asked to sit first: eager, bare-armed, before the sitting, in the vent village's dawn.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of an eager boy at dawn on the day of the first sitting. Face: a young round face, wide-open dark eyes, thick black brows, a firm young jaw, a bright, brave, impatient smile, a smear of ash on one cheek. His skin is smooth and fresh, his teeth are bright, and the bridge of his nose is dusted with a few freckles. Hair: black, tied in a plain topknot with a red cord. Body: a lean, strong boy with broad shoulders, bare arms with no scars yet. Clothing: a sleeveless new red tunic, a red sash still stiff, folded neatly; bare arms smooth and unscarred. The new tunic still shows its fold lines across the chest, and a short cord of red thread is tied round his wrist for luck. Hands and objects: both hands pressed together in front of his chest in an oath gesture, then a small black stone resting on a cloth in front of him. Background: a soft pale dawn sky, a hint of vent smoke. On the ground before him a plain black stone lies on a folded cloth, and behind him low dark houses of the vent village rise, with a single thread of smoke. Light: warm pale gold from the upper left, fading like old paint. The yellowing and the dark edges are heaviest at the corners, leaving his face the clearest part. Expression: a bright, eager face with wide eyes and parted lips leaning forward, the look of a boy who cannot wait, rendered soft and faded.

people.imagined: Memorial of the best fighter of her day on the autumn of 1162, standing at the vent's mouth about to go in, hands steady, hair half undone for the rite.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a woman at the lip of a vent with her face lifted. Face: a strong, proud face with sharp cheekbones, a long jaw, thick straight brows, fierce dark eyes, a firm mouth, lines of resolve at the brow; skin tanned with a faint red burn at the neck. The scar on her neck is from an old burn, a pale ripple of skin below the jaw, and her teeth are strong and even. Hair: long black hair with two white streaks, half unbound for the rite, the rest in a tight red-corded knot. Body: tall and strong, straight shoulders. Clothing: a sleeveless deep red dress cut at the knee, bare arms white with dense pale scar lines to the shoulder, a heavy red sash tied tight, a thin dark-red band round her forehead. Her bare arms carry so many fine scar lines that they look braided, white against tan, and the forehead band is a plain dark-red cord. Hands and objects: both hands open at her sides, palms forward; at her throat a small carved red-stone bead on a cord. Background: dark rock and a column of orange light rising at the left. A rough stone lip of the vent curves behind her in ash-grey rock, and thin streamers of heat rise above it. Light: orange from the lower left fading to old-silk yellow. The edges of the portrait are brown and cracked like old silk, and the orange glow has dulled to a faded amber. Expression: a calm, lifted face with steady eyes and a firm, still mouth, the jaw set and no trace of fear, rendered soft and faded.
